test_title: PYST 54: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: If P + Q means P is the brother of Q. P × Q means P is the mother of Q. P ÷ Q means P is the father of Q and P - Q means P is the sister of Q. If A × B ÷ C - D + E - F, then how is A related to E?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 ×
 ÷
 -
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Mother
 Father
 Sister
 
 

 

**Given:** A × B ÷ C - D + E - F

So,

 
• A × B → A is the mother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cecae6902277e6a5a805cdef9f4f454f73e04f7457b3c86c36d468923382d151.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0727392bc23f4bac7b016f8984f3b0e6d82bece79cfb4241131bd3266a33b73f.png] 

 
• B ÷ C → B is the father of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdd84acb327b94f9692f3ae9124fe558d74cbc16d6a5bb9fb27b7b0b6fe4e843.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a542512ee53abecfc689b99df6bbc1d0f45bcaa59f2ccd4568212f63c8497c7.png] 

 
• C - D → C is the sister of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b83b2e2218a5dc387b8c46b21c0989b50d811a6ce28f6893a57c660ea56da0f4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/faceb72968589fe6f8f3a9a7eb9210bbf4591c567b4057223e06021a8eb240ad.png] 

 
• D + E → D is the brother of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ed15d99130a0fbc4744f310e51d8b9436d14a4f6ccd4ad755d3d8692a8bf27b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9b74a5c279f5de4f14753291936853358a68deb17f876c725aeb3211d74069d.png] 

 
• E - F → E is the sister of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26840b0b58e09597292e371b4d4eac8aac68bff28fd451b00a0065812148322f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc96e7f3b1b5905392d4f94b9762c875e027fa37ba811ffdd9ef7a8eac8c37eb.png] 

So, A is the 'paternal grandmother i.e father's mother' of E.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (1)".
